en.headline: Swire Pacific first-half underlying profit rises 43% to HK$7.84 billion
en.dek: The conglomerate reported higher contributions from property, beverages and aviation, declared an increased interim dividend and said it is making its largest-ever investments across businesses.
body: Swire Pacific reported underlying profit of HK$7.84 billion for the six months to 30 June, up 43 per cent from a year earlier, driven by stronger performances across its property, beverages and aviation divisions.

Revenue rose 8 per cent to HK$49.45 billion. Recurring underlying profit, excluding one-off items, increased 48 per cent to HK$6.96 billion. The board declared a first interim dividend of HK$1.50 per A share and HK$0.30 per B share, up 15 per cent.

Property arm Swire Properties contributed higher earnings on solid retail sales and improved residential transactions. The beverages division improved, particularly in mainland China, while the aviation businesses, including HAECO and Cathay Pacific, also performed strongly despite higher fuel costs in the second quarter.
Chairman Guy Bradley said the group is undertaking its largest-ever investments to support future growth and expects the business environment to improve further in the remainder of the year.

zh.headline: 太古上半年基本溢利升43%至78.4億元 中期息增15%
zh.dek: 太古股份公司公布中期業績，基本溢利78.43億元，地產、飲料及航空業務均有改善，A股派中期息1.5元。
body: 太古股份公司公布截至6月30日止六個月業績，股東應佔基本溢利78.43億元，按年上升43%；經常性基本溢利69.62億元，升48%。
期內收益494.46億元，按年增長8%。董事局宣布派發第一次中期股息，A股每股1.5元、B股每股0.3元，按年增加15%。
地產部門受惠於穩健零售銷售及較佳住宅買賣市場；飲料業務尤其是中國內地表現改善；航空部門方面，港機集團表現理想，國泰雖面對燃油成本上升，但年初表現強勁。
主席白德利表示，集團正於各項業務作出歷來最大投資以支持未來增長，並預期餘下時間營商環境將進一步改善。
